premises.text: 98% of educational content is static and linear because it takes too much time and money to produce
premises.evidence_span: 98% of this content is both static and linear. Only 2% of it is dynamic. The reason for this is it takes such a lot of time and money to produce.

premises.text: Learner needs and future jobs are unpredictable, yet course development takes months to years
premises.evidence_span: our educational systems are forced to guess because it'll take them months, if not years, to develop courses

premises.text: Knowledge AI generates interactive bite-sized e-learning packages 100 times faster, plug-and-play for any learning environment
premises.evidence_span: we're able to generate interactive bite-sized e-education, e-learning packages, 100 times faster, plug-and-play ready for any learning environment

premises.text: Knowledge LX generates full learning experiences in near real time from a latent space of concepts between the learner and their goal
premises.evidence_span: We do this by generating a latent space of all the concepts that lie between the learner's current understanding and their learning goal.

premises.text: A behind-the-scenes provider model lets partner platforms supply distribution through LMS integrations
premises.evidence_span: We focus on being the behind-the-scenes, AI-ready solutions provider, while our partners provide distribution through their platforms.

value.text: Courseware that used to take 40-50 hours to produce is generated in minutes, for any learning goal
value.evidence_span: What used to take 40, 50 hours can now be done in just minutes.

secondary_value.text: Learning experiences that tap the learner's intrinsic motivation
secondary_value.evidence_span: a future where we can tap into the learner's intrinsic motivation and generate real-life learning experiences in real time

causal_links.evidence_span: It's no longer clear what problems our learners need to solve tomorrow, nor is it clear what jobs will be available or what we should train them for.
generate interactive bite-sized e-education, e-learning packages, 100 times faster
Knowledge as a service is already being used by multiple platforms who can simply plug us in.

notes: Demo feature list (interactive video, glossary, flashcards, quiz bank, games, teacher materials) folded into the generation premise per v1.3.2 clarification 5; the exoskeleton story is validation evidence for LX, not a separate premise. Usage, contract, and ARR figures and team exits excluded per 4.2. Partition is a need/product/channel triad; justification per 4.5(5): the production-cost problem can be re-read without touching the generation technology, and the partner-distribution bet is revised separately from the AI engine, as the staged integration rollout shows. Singleton D3 retained for that reason.
